title: Poetry
note: Quiet moral reckoning on guilt, beauty, complicity; profound and restrained.

title: La La Land
note: Lush musical craft, bittersweet, but ideas thin; divides cinephiles sharply.

title: Seven Samurai
note: Foundational action grammar, deep humanism; endlessly rewatchable epic.

title: In the Mood for Love
note: Mood, restraint, longing rendered formally; indelible affective imprint.

title: Parasite
note: Class allegory in tight genre control; accessible yet substantive.

title: City Lights
note: Silent comedy-pathos peak; final shot indelible, formally masterful.

title: Spirited Away
note: Imaginative animation, moral growth; rewards rewatch across ages.

title: The Godfather
note: American tragedy of power and corruption; flawless classical form.

title: 12 Angry Men
note: Single-room moral procedural on doubt and justice; tightly constructed.

title: A Separation
note: Moral ambiguity without villains; ethical complexity rendered concretely.

title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
note: Gaze, desire, memory examined; painterly, intellectually disciplined romance.

title: Moonlight
note: Tender identity triptych; sensory form, real emotional and moral weight.

title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
note: Perceptual revolution on evolution and consciousness; medium-enlarging form.

title: The Tree of Life
note: Cosmic-domestic grace meditation; formally radical, deeply divisive ambition.

title: Mulholland Drive
note: Dream-logic deconstruction of Hollywood desire; inexhaustible, unnerving.

title: Synecdoche, New York
note: Recursive meditation on art, mortality, self; dense, devastating, polarizing.

title: Jeanne Dielman
note: Duration as feminist form; radically reorganizes attention and domestic labor.

title: Antichrist
note: Grief, nature, misogyny confronted brutally; gorgeous, provocative, savagely divisive.

title: Holy Motors
note: Cinema-as-performance metamorphosis; inventive, allusive, exhilaratingly strange.

title: Uncut Gems
note: Relentless anxiety machine; immersive craft, thin durable substance.

title: Beau Is Afraid
note: Anxious odyssey of guilt; ambitious sprawl, indulgent, sharply divisive.

title: Close-Up
note: Reality-fiction blur on identity and cinema; reorganizes documentary thought.

title: Enemy
note: Doppelganger dread, control, subjugation; cryptic, atmospheric puzzle-box.

title: Climax
note: Choreographed descent into chaos; virtuosic camera, provocative, hollow center.

title: Batman Returns
note: Gothic auteur blockbuster; expressive design, tonally odd, cultishly divisive.

title: Top Gun: Maverick
note: Superb practical spectacle; nostalgic, ideologically safe, thin durable value.

title: Ocean's Eleven
note: Effortless cool heist craft; stylish, frictionless, low intellectual stakes.

title: Ant-Man
note: Genial franchise filler; competent, formulaic, negligible durable substance.

title: John Wick
note: Balletic gun-fu craft and world-building; stylish, mythic, thematically slim.

title: Crazy Rich Asians
note: Glossy crowd-pleaser; cultural visibility, conventional romcom, low durable yield.

title: The Hangover
note: Mystery-structured comedy; brisk fun, crude, evaporates after laughs.

title: Jurassic World
note: Self-aware nostalgia spectacle; hollow, cynically derivative, negligible substance.

title: Knives Out
note: Clever whodunit with class satire; entertaining, well-built, modestly substantive.

title: The Intouchables
note: Crowd-pleasing odd-couple uplift; warm but sentimental, racially questioned, manipulative.

title: Free Guy
note: Game-world high-concept comedy; amiable, corporate, ideas underexploited.

title: Babylon
note: Maximalist Hollywood requiem; dazzling excess, tonal chaos, fiercely divisive.

title: Cloud Atlas
note: Ambitious interwoven epic on connection; earnest sprawl, uneven, polarizing.

title: The Counselor
note: Nihilist McCarthy parable on consequence; talky, bleak, critically reassessed.

title: Joker
note: Scorsese-pastiche character study; provocative, derivative, ideologically combustible, divisive.

title: Don't Look Up
note: Blunt climate satire; topical urgency, smug execution, sharply polarizing.

title: Star Wars: The Last Jedi
note: Subversive franchise entry; ambitious choices within blockbuster, ferociously divisive.

title: Sucker Punch
note: Stylized empowerment fantasy; visual overload, muddled, self-defeating, contentious.

title: Spring Breakers
note: Neon critique of hedonist culture; formally bold, slippery, intensely divisive.

title: The Fountain
note: Earnest mortality-spanning poem; visually striking, overreaching, love-it-or-hate-it.

title: Southland Tales
note: Apocalyptic satire sprawl; chaotic ambition, incoherent, cult-divisive misfire.

title: Suicide Squad
note: Tonally mangled franchise product; studio-mutilated, incoherent, near-empty.

title: Vox Lux
note: Fame-and-violence century portrait; formally ambitious, cold, contentious.

title: Avatar: The Way of Water
note: Technical immersion landmark; spectacular craft, simplistic story, thematically thin.

title: Mamma Mia!
note: Exuberant jukebox confection; joyful, slapdash, negligible durable substance.

title: Now You See Me
note: Flashy magic-heist; kinetic surface, implausible, hollow, quickly forgotten.
